A '''fern''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="CSWERazorFern" /> Types of fern included [[amber fern]]s,<ref name="Sacrifice" /> [[Blood Razor fern]]s,<ref name="TOR:GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref> [[bull-fern]]s,<ref name="CSWEIthor" /> [[Climbing fern/Legends|climbing ferns]],<ref name="CSWEYavin4" /> [[Dantooine fern]]s,<ref name="DantooineFern">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=item|Dantooine Fern (Potted)|the Dantooine dynamic encounters}}</ref> [[feather fern]]s,<ref name="CSWEYavin4" /> [[glass-fern]]s,<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> [[Jovarian sun fern]]s,<ref name="Galladinium" /> [[kata-wata]],<ref name="Gamer9">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> [[razor fern]]s,<ref name="CSWERazorFern" /> [[shag fern]]s,<ref name="AoC1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref> [[singing fern]]s,<ref name="SoF" /> [[splinter fern]]s, and [[tentacle fern]]s.<ref name="GunganFrontier" /> There were thousands of [[Species/Legends|species]] of ferns on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Joralla]].<ref name="TSWPC" /> At least one type of ferns was violet in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="TOR" />

Ferns and [[Lichen/Legends|lichens]] were the dominant form of vegetation in the mediocre soil of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="DES" /> Ferns even grew on the surface of the [[Poison/Legends|toxic]], garbage-covered planet of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].<ref name="Crossfire" />

[[Fern-tree]]s, plants found on the planet [[Duroon]], were similar to ferns.<ref name="StarsEnd" /> Ferns shared their name with [[crystal fern]]s, possibly [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]]-based [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Species/Legends|life-forms]],<ref name="CSWECrystalFern">{{CSWECite|I|154|crystal fern}}</ref> and [[fern bicker]]s, a species of [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] creature living on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWG">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

Besides growing in wilderness,<ref name="Splinter" /> ferns were also grown in-doors, such as in the [[Jungle Vault]] [[Club/Legends|club]] on the planet [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]],<ref name="VaynaiArchipelago">{{GamerCite|8|The Vaynai Archipelago}}</ref> in [[Administrator Senior]] [[Lob Doluff]]'s office on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oseon 6845]],<ref name="Lando">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> and in [[Garden/Legends|gardens]] on [[Ithorian Herdship]]s.<ref name="Children">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
One namesake of the fern, the fern [[Potato/Legends|potato]], was mentioned in the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by [[Bob Carrau]].<ref name="Monsters">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in the book is [[Canon|non-canonical]]<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref> with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref>

===''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas''===
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
A fern potato was a [[Diet/Legends|cooking]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|ingredient]] that could be used in preparing a dish out of the creature known as [[Smapp]]. One recipe listed 45 fern potatoes among its required ingredients.<ref name="Monsters" />
{{Noncanonend}}
